description: Offline Android PDF viewer, scanner, OCR and document tools, ad-supported with optional remove-ads IAP
last_completed_task: P12 implementation: disposable sessions with cache-file state, Documents v2 with persisted folders and search, full-screen tool shell with selection rules and Result screen, Scan v2 with ImageAnalysis and reachable Pages/Export/OCR, QR removal with Room v2 migration. Verified: release signed v2, zipalign 16KB, unit tests, 8 instrumented tests including 1->2 migration, five release screenshots. Remaining: V5/V6/V7/V8 instrumented UI assertions and physical-device evidence.

open_questions.question: Which platform ships first?

open_questions.answer: PDF Pocket (working name; trademark and Play Store check still required at P5.2)

open_questions.question: OCR languages for v1?
open_questions.recommendation: English + Arabic — covers UAE users and the largest local need

decisions.decision: Ideas 1, 2 and 7 are one app, not three
decisions.reason: Shared on-device file pipeline and one install; user instruction 2026-11-23

decisions.decision: No backend, account, upload or watermark in v1
decisions.reason: This is the only differentiator against free incumbents with 1M+ ratings

decisions.decision: Ads primary, optional one-time remove-ads IAP
decisions.reason: User's stated strategy; ad-only leaves money on the table

decisions.decision: No paid user acquisition before ASO evidence
decisions.reason: Modelled need is 2,100–18,500 DAU for $1k/mo; paid UA cannot be justified pre-retention data

decisions.decision: P12 sessions are disposable unique-id sessions; only Recents survives
decisions.reason: FLOWS3 principle 3: no stale files or output when a tool is reopened

decisions.decision: Page tools honour selection; Compress, Unlock and Protect are whole-document tools
decisions.reason: FLOWS3 table: destructive defaults must be safe and whole-document actions must not pretend to be page actions
